capabilities.title: Document template creation: drag-and-drop field placement on PDF/Word documents
capabilities.sourceEvidence: DocuSeal template builder: visual field placement for signature, text, date, checkbox
capabilities.reason: Nexus is an intelligence dashboard, not a document signing platform. DocuSeal's core product is out of scope.

capabilities.title: Electronic signature request and collection workflow
capabilities.sourceEvidence: DocuSeal: send, sign, and collect legally-binding e-signatures
capabilities.reason: E-signature workflows are out of scope for Nexus.

capabilities.title: PDF field extraction: parse form fields and metadata from PDF documents
capabilities.sourceEvidence: DocuSeal PDF processing pipeline: field extraction for template mapping
capabilities.reason: PDF form extraction requires an untrusted-binary parser, strict resource limits, and a document-intelligence retention boundary. Nexus keeps local manual extracted-text intake rather than presenting a partial parser as safe.

capabilities.title: Self-hosted document processing server with REST API
capabilities.sourceEvidence: DocuSeal self-hosted deployment with REST API
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not need a separate self-hosted document server; all features run within the Next.js app.
